description: Read-only follow-up on the later owner testnet ETH-PERP position. This is separate from the October 26 open-and-close demonstration.
indexerObservation: The indexer reports PositionLiquidated, KeeperReward and AccountLiquidated stages in this transaction. The listed liquidation events were decoded from the transaction receipt using the SDK ABI; the emitter matches the MarginBank system configuration at this block.
limitations: This is not complete net PnL. The relationship between the liquidation fee, keeper reward and other costs has not been reconciled; they must not simply be summed. Gas and missing or ambiguous history require separate verification. RPC data is not proof-authenticated. The account and market pool are public testnet addresses.
